title: Mayor Earl Cabell, brother Charles Cabell of CIA, motorcade route

tellings.quote: Um the mayor of Dallas was a guy named Earl Cabel. Yeah. And um his his brother Charles was Dallas's number two at the CIA on the Bay of Pigs.

plain: Michels points out that the mayor of Dallas when President Kennedy was shot there was Earl Cabell, and that Cabell's brother, Charles Cabell, was the CIA's number two at the time of the Bay of Pigs, the failed 1961 invasion of Cuba backed by the United States. Michels raises this himself, in an episode on Kennedy's death, as a possible link between the CIA and the city that planned Kennedy's motorcade route.
